services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Loads of fun, amazing friendships and growing faith. A week at our Manitoba summer camp will change your life. EXPLORERS see the world through their imagination and can find fun in just about everything. At Camp, the world becomes a playground full of new things to explore. They get to fly into the sky at Flying Squirrel, take a Corcl out on the lake and let their imagination run free in the Creator’s Studio! While they’re busy discovering the world around them, they have caring Cabin Leads looking out for them to make sure they are getting all they need.
